# Daily Report — 2026-10-12

## Task Completed
Added `list_sla_schedules` and `get_sla_schedule` tools to `sla_tools.py`.

Both tools work with the `cmn_schedule` table linked to `contract_sla` via its
`schedule` reference field.

- **`list_sla_schedules`**: lists `cmn_schedule` records with optional `sla_id`
  filter (scopes to the schedule assigned to that SLA), plus `name_query`,
  `active`, and `time_zone` filters. Full pagination with `has_more`/`next_offset`.
- **`get_sla_schedule`**: retrieves a single schedule by either direct
  `schedule_id` (cmn_schedule sys_id or name) or `sla_id` (contract_sla sys_id
  or name, auto-resolves through the SLA's `schedule` field). 404/empty-result
  guards on both paths.

Both tools registered in `__init__.py`, `tool_utils.py`, `tool_packages.yaml`
(service_desk, system_administrator, full packages).
